name: month_successor
description: Name the month that is k months after a given month. Control: same format with integer addition.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];control=[]
for m in range(12):
    for k in [1,2,3,4]:
        items.append({"prompt":f"Q: Which month comes {k} month{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {M[m]}?\nA: It is","answer":" "+M[(m+k)%12]})
random.shuffle(items)
for i in range(48):
    n=random.randint(2,40);k=random.choice([1,2,3,4])
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Which number comes {k} after {n}?\nA: It is","answer":" "+str(n+k)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
